name: mysql-audit
description: MySQL migration and query safety review for AI agents: locks, table copies, data loss, injection.
long_description: Reviews MySQL DDL, migration scripts, queries and application code before they run. Flags table copies and write locks (Online DDL ALGORITHM/LOCK), metadata-lock stalls, foreign keys added with checks on, data loss from DROP/RENAME, unbatched backfills, queries without a usable index, integer overflow and SQL built by string concatenation. Each finding comes with the impact and a safe rewrite. Runs locally; your SQL never leaves your machine.

tools.name: review_migration
tools.description: Review MySQL DDL or a migration script for locking, data-loss and replication risks.

tools.name: review_query
tools.description: Review application queries for missing indexes, full scans and unsafe writes.

tools.name: review_code
tools.description: Find SQL built by string concatenation or interpolation in application code.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain one rule: why it matters and a safe example.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List every rule with its id, title and default severity.
